rules: The existing 15 EUR per-game/per-draw cap is an exceptional ceiling, never a spending target.
All games compete for one future global bankroll; budgets are not additive game by game.
Zero EUR is always a valid and preferred decision when no candidate clears the evidence gate.
Multiple shadows for the same game and draw are research alternatives and must never be summed as separate real-money allocations.
No monthly real-money budget is activated until explicitly configured; research remains SHADOW/PAPER/PROSPECTIVE.
Never chase losses, increase cadence after losses, or convert retrospective significance into real-money approval.
Prefer fewer high-evidence draws over routine daily participation.
Any future allocation must be selected before the target result and remain inside both the global monthly cap and the per-game/per-draw hard cap.
